definition: Said of an assembly that rises up the wall plane, bottom to top, as a wall section does: each member's figure is a height, and the plate stands it on the floor line. A casing, which runs across from the jamb, is drawn turned instead.
basis: Our wording, read from the pack schema's assemblies and axis fields and the classical trim family's casing member notes. schema/proportion-pack.schema.json, assemblies description: "Each assembly is a stack of members, bottom to top, dimensioned in PARTS of the module."; schema/proportion-pack.schema.json, axis description: "up-the-wall: the members stack bottom to top, as an order and a wall section do"; proportions/systems/trim-classical.json assemblies.casing_georgian.members[geo_cas_reveal].note: "This assembly is measured ACROSS the casing from the jamb outward rather than vertically; height_parts is therefore a width.".
